candidates.title: Prepare a reviewed callback log from call notes

demandEvidence.chore: School administrator work includes answering the switchboard and providing administrative support to leadership; a narrow experiment could turn operator supplied fictional call notes into a callback log for staff review.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I rollen ingår även arbete i växel samt administrativt stöd till ledningen

ease.reason: A beginner could format fictional operator supplied call notes into a callback log, but no attached source supports the parsing mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school may value less call logging work; this paid staff notice does not show demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two week mock can produce a log from synthetic notes; call handling rules, integrations and real records are outside scope.

autonomy.reason: Formatting supplied notes is repeatable, but a staff member must verify callbacks and handle every real conversation; no implementation reference is attached.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly names switchboard work, but gives no call volume, logging process, constraints or software evidence.

candidates.reason: The bounded fictional callback-log experiment is assessable, but implementation mechanics lack attached support and the five ratings average 4.6, below the threshold of 6.

rejected.title: Paid school administrator role
rejected.reason: The notice contains only a role and publication date, with no concrete task to scope; inventing school duties or demandEvidence would be unsupported.

steps.message: Assessed both selected education notices. One names switchboard work and supports a narrow fictional callback-log assessment, but its mean is 4.6 and no building reference supports implementation; the second notice has no concrete task. No post meets threshold.
